fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for each university record (e.g. 'university_001').

fields.name: name
fields.description: Official name of the university (e.g. 'Cairo University').

fields.name: category
fields.description: Type of institution the record represents (e.g. 'University').

fields.name: address
fields.description: Street address of the university (e.g. '164 El Nil Street').

fields.name: district
fields.description: District or neighborhood where the university is located (e.g. 'University District').

fields.name: opening_hours
fields.description: Daily opening and closing times in 'HH:MM-HH:MM' format (e.g. '08:00-18:00').

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Main contact phone number, including country code (e.g. '+20-2-2204-5506').

fields.name: website
fields.description: Official website URL of the university.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude coordinate of the university location (WGS84), the first value of the Point geometry.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude coordinate of the university location (WGS84), the second value of the Point geometry.
